title: Add track integrity check to wakeup Step 7 — detect incomplete entries
description: Wakeup protocol Step 7 (Display Briefing) should validate track.jsonl before showing it. Quick check: last entry must have all required fields (turn, ts, focus, action, thinking, activity, decisions, insights, open, phase, evolution) OR be explicitly marked `completed: true`. If invalid/incomplete: surface '⚠️ Session interrupted at Turn N' in briefing.
acceptance: Wakeup Step 7a new substep: Validate most recent session's track.jsonl
Check final entry: all required fields present OR `completed: true` flag
If invalid: flag in briefing as 'Session interrupted at Turn {N} ({timestamp})'
If valid: continue normal briefing display
No autosave/recovery logic yet (that's epic-interruption-recovery-v1) — just detection
impact: Immediate visibility into interruptions. Users know instantly if last session crashed.
routing_notes: Quick win on path to full recovery epic. Validates track schema.
